units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 19:14">Targ. O. Deut. XIX, 14</cite> <he>תָּחִימוּ</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. <he>תְּ׳</he>, corr. acc.); Y. <he>אַתְחִימוּ</he> (not <cite ref="A01641"><he>אִתְ׳</he></cite>).
